case_name = base
mode = lmp
modules = RC01_ST, RC10_RCAD

[source_term]

[receptor]

y_m = 0.0
z_m = 0.0

stability_class = D
wind_speed_m_s = 3.0
mixing_height_m = none

[release]

duration_s = 3600.0
height_m = 0.0

organ = ICRP60ED

[decay]

simple_decay_at_receptor = false

deposition_velocities_by_group = 0,0.003,0.003,0.003,0.003,0.003,0.003,0.003,0,0.003

[outputs]
write_csv = true
output_dir = outputs
